criteria.reason: Simple metaphors (rulebook, class vote) and warm, direct address fit a 10-year-old well.
100,000 signatures correct, but the required 18-month collection deadline is omitted.
Engaging but overlong, with tangents and emoji-heavy sections beyond concise scope.

factual_errors: Paternity-leave vote was September 2020, not 2021; 18-month signature deadline omitted
summary: Child-friendly and accurate on signatures and the final nationwide vote, but it omits the 18-month deadline and is overlong.
